newsitem.title: UK: IBCA gives Folgate Insurance BBB claims rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA gives Folgate Insurance BBB claims rating.

text.p: European rating agency IBCA said on Monday it assigned a BBB claims settling ability rating to Folgate Insurance Company Limited, based in Poole, England.

"Folgate, is licensed to write all classes of general business except Assistance, but maintains a predominantly personal lines account, with a small amount of commercial property business," IBCA said in a statement.
It said Folgate is wholly owned by Wurttembergische Aktiengesellschaft Versicherungs Beteiligungsgesellschaft, a holding company based in Germany.

"The company has undergone significant restructuring over the past two years. Substantial investment in IT and personnel has dented profitability, but the benefits are expected to start to emerge during 1997," IBCA said.
But IBCA said it was unlikely that the combined ratio would fall to below 100 percent before 1998.
"Wurttembergische is committed to the continued development of the business and this has been demonstrated by its willingness to increase paid up share capital between 1994 and 1996.
"In IBCA's opinion the strong parental support and structural changes provide a satisfactory base for future development," the statement said.
